{"decision": "APPLY", "workflow_yaml": "# This workflow will install Python dependencies, run tests and lint with a variety of Python versions
# For more information see: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/automating-builds-and-tests/building-and-testing-python

name: ci-cd

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "production" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "production" ]

jobs:
  build:

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            python-version: "3.9"
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            python-version: "3.10"
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            python-version: "3.11"
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            python-version: "3.12"
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            python-version: "3.13"
          - os: windows-latest
            python-version: "3.9"
          - os: windows-latest
            python-version: "3.10"
          - os: windows-latest
            python-version: "3.11"
          - os: windows-latest
            python-version: "3.12"
          - os: windows-latest
            python-version: "3.13"
          - os: macos-latest
            python-version: "3.11"
          - os: macos-latest
            python-version: "3.12"
          - os: macos-latest
            python-version: "3.13"

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      id: cp310
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        architecture: x64
    - name: Cache pip dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/pip
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        python -m pip install flake8 pytest
        python -m pip install -e ./
        python -m pip install -U setuptools
    - name: Lint with flake8
      run: |
        # stop the build if there are Python syntax errors or undefined names
        flake8 . --count --select=E9,F63,F7,F82 --show-source --statistics
        # exit-zero treats all errors as warnings. The GitHub editor is 127 chars wide
        flake8 . --count --exit-zero --max-complexity=10 --max-line-length=127 --statistics
    - name: Test with pytest
      run: |
        python -m pip install -e ./
        python -m pytest", "rationale": "The workflow runs a 13-job matrix (3 OS x 5 Python versions) and reinstalls pip dependencies on every run with no dependency cache. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE literature pattern (measured modest VM-time reduction) and the experiment example (adding actions/cache@v4 for pip keyed on hashFiles('pyproject.toml')) support caching pip dependencies. pyproject.toml exists in the repository, so the cache key is valid, and no equivalent cache already exists. The change inserts a single cache step between setup and install, preserving all lint and pytest coverage across the full matrix, adding no privileged actions, secrets, publishing/deployment operations, or new network access.", "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2"]}
